=

📚 Welcome to AuthorsLab.ai

Hi {{ $json.firstName }}! 👋

Great news! Your AuthorsLab.ai beta tester account has been created and is ready to use.

I'm Alex, your developmental editor. Together, we'll transform your manuscript through five phases of professional editing, from story structure all the way to publication and marketing.

Your Login Credentials

Email: {{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.email }}

Temporary Password: {{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.tempPassword }}

⚠️ Important: Please change your password after logging in for the first time.

📋 Before You Log In: Prepare Your Manuscript

After logging in, you'll be asked to upload your manuscript. Here's what you need to have ready:

1. Convert to PDF Format

We currently accept PDF files only. If your manuscript is in Word (.docx), save it as a PDF first.

2. Format Your Chapter Markers

Before converting to PDF, make sure your chapters are clearly labeled:

Prologue

Chapter 1

Chapter 2 - The Journey Begins

Chapter 3

Epilogue

✅ Good chapter markers:

  • "Prologue" (if you have one)
  • "Chapter 1" or "Chapter 1 - Your Title"
  • "Chapter 2", "Chapter 3", etc.
  • "Epilogue" (if you have one)

❌ Avoid:

  • Missing chapter numbers
  • Roman numerals (use 1, 2, 3 instead)
  • Inconsistent formatting between chapters

3. Know Your Details

You'll need to provide:

  • Book Title - Your manuscript's title
  • Genre - Fiction category (e.g., Fantasy, Romance, Thriller)
  • Number of Chapters - Count your numbered chapters only (don't include Prologue or Epilogue)
  • Prologue/Epilogue - Just tick the boxes if you have them

✅ What Happens After Upload

  1. Your manuscript is processed and chapters are automatically parsed
  2. You'll be taken to your Author Studio
  3. Click "Read My Manuscript" and I'll spend about 5 minutes analyzing your story
  4. You'll get a comprehensive PDF report by email (~15 minutes)
  5. Then we start editing together, one chapter at a time!
Login to Your Studio →

As a beta tester, you get full access to all editing phases completely free. Your feedback helps us build the best AI editing platform for authors.

Have questions about formatting or the upload process? Just reply to this email - I'm here to help!

— Alex, Your Developmental Editor
